chunks.content:
## Additional Course Details

This course requires attendance only.  At most two unexcused absences are permitted.  More than two unexcused absences will result in an unsatisfactory grade.

## Course Learning Outcomes

Upon completion of this course, the learner will be able to:

- Understand Industrial and Systems Engineering research trends.

## Special Course Designation

None

## Textbook and/or Resource Materials

This material Is: Required

No materials are required.

## Grading Policy

This course is S/U and grading is attendance based.  Any more than two unexcused absences will result in an unsatisfactory (U) grade.

## Late Work Policy

Work submitted by a student as makeup work for an excused absence is not considered late work and is exempt from the late work policy (Student Rule 7).

## Course Schedule

A seminar is held weekly, with the speaker listed under Assignments.
